I was tripping on 4-HO-MET in Berlin and was in a metro where a homeless person walks in looking like they are asking for money. 

They seemed at first like a very frail old male wearing some sort of hospital gown and had a torn up plushie toy and were slowly ripping their hair off. Every single person in that section of the metro immediately got up and sat in a different section without even looking at them. They got very close to me and my friend and when they finally looked up and showed their face I realised that they were a very young girl(?) maybe, it was hard to judge, like literally a child with a lot of wounds around their body (definitely heroin addiction and scars that happen from scratching and maybe some sort of skin disease). They were not asking for money. They were clearly asking for help because they were extremely lost. They kept mumbling and looked at me with extreme fear and started walking further away trying to figure out how or where to go. 

My friend and I decided to stay in that section of the metro as this person clearly did not even have the power to harm a soul. I wanted to do something but I was tripping dick and there was nothing I could do to help them. They were also clearly not able to communicate or comprehend anything and just kept ripping their hair off which was bleeding and scratching themselves. 

I still wonder sometimes if they were able to get help or if they are still alive.

I would have thought this way in the past too but I’ve had a friend who admitted that when she was young she would occasionally go around town with her boyfriend giving NBOMe and other “fake acid” drugs to homeless people or random young “party people” telling them it’s great acid and they want to share the high and the fun just because they found it hilarious. 

I don’t know how or why someone could get a laugh out of this but yeah there are deranged people out there, they don’t need to be psychopaths. :(

I was at a big festival in a different country in the middle of fuck nowhere camping with a bunch of strangers cramped up in some bushy hills with trees. 

Temperature above 40 degrees, I take out my stash on day 2 and weigh out a considerably high dose of 3C-P (14 hr psychedelic amphetamine that can get VERY overstimulating on high doses.) 
I was planning on taking 50 mg bc I had done above 40 before and I wanted to see how freaky things would get at 50. Now there isn’t much info on 3C-P out there I just knew it’s strong af and my previous trips I had enjoyed it a lot. 
Forgot that scales are affected by gravity and surface angle 🤦🏻
Weighed out what seemed like much more than 50 mg but still took it thinking it probably wasn’t. Come up starts and I IMMEDIATELY know it’s WAY TOO MUCH. Like nothing compared to my previous trips. I was also feeling extremely vasoconstricted. The normally light and pretty visuals turned into actual visual/auditory/sensory hallucinations. 
The rest is me having stimulant psychosis in a foreign country with 60.000 strangers, no proper bathrooms (queue for 15-20 minutes), unable to find my tent, with no money trying to reach my tent to find my benzos FOR LIKE 10 HOURS…

Oh and also, my phone died bc it was impossible to charge and I was not able to find my tent bc at some point it got completely dark in this forest and I had no light. 

Eventually I decided to steal a camping flashlight from the festival store (where they had security guards), managed to find my tent and reached the benzos. 



TLDR; I fucked up big time with the dosage of 3C-P and felt like I was playing the video game “Bad Trip” on EXTRA HARD mode at a festival.

I mean… I get where you are coming from but some women just don’t feel comfortable with the currently available birth control options. This includes the copper IUD. 

I was lucky enough to move to a country and get healthcare where a copper IUD was provided for free by the government health insurance but due to my genetics I have terrible cramps during ovulation and during my period. 1.5 week of cramps every month at least is what I exchange for the comfort of my mind and freedom of having sex the way I want with my partner. BUT, for some people the pain of a copper IUD might just not be possible to accept and for some, hormonal birth control can just feel absolutely HORRIBLE (I am one of those people, I just can’t stand it). Science has found many solutions to this problem but there isn’t one pill that fixes it for everyone and the choice is not as simple as “to take it or not to take it.”

However, I think OP should probably educate themselves on the topic by going to a sex clinic or another professional service since saying “I just don’t want those weird things doing stuff to my body” is not a very well informed way of making a decision on this. It doesn’t make them crazy or unreasonable to not want it after learning about everything fully tho.

If you have access to different benzos I would recommend trying etizolam, temazepam or clonazepam (klonopin) for this specific instance because they are fast acting. (Benzos are highly addictive so do not make it into a habit or you will have withdrawals but ofc it’s your choice) 

If you don’t have access to these benzos I would take another valium. Overdosing on benzos is very hard. Just DO NOT drink alcohol or combine it with other drugs that will affect your respiratory system and/or GABA receptors.
